cases.prompt: Explain how sessions are issued, checked, renewed, and revoked. Identify whether a revoked session can be renewed.
cases.expected_explanation: Issue stores expiry and clears revocation; validation checks existence, expiry, and revocation; renewal rejects absent/revoked tokens; revoke marks and deletes.

cases.prompt: Explain when cached source and the lexical index are reused, what rejects an incompatible cache, and how a rebuilt cache replaces the old file.
cases.expected_explanation: Reuse needs matching fingerprints; schema/build compatibility and ranges are validated; unchanged complete files permit index reuse; flushed temp cache is renamed.

cases.prompt: Explain identifier segmentation including letters, numbers, camel case, acronyms and Unicode, and how matching handles related word forms.
cases.expected_explanation: Nonalphanumeric splits, case/acronym and alphabetic-status transitions split, lowercase is Unicode aware; equality, bounded stemming and prefixes relate terms.
